description: Post a first comment that failed, again. A first comment never fails its post, so a published post can be carrying first_comment with status "failed" and a reason; this re-sends the text the post already holds. That text cannot be changed once the post is out, because chirpie_update_post refuses a published post with 409 post_not_editable, so set it while the post is still a draft or still queued. A first comment is a post on the platform, so a retry that works costs one post from the monthly quota, exactly as the first attempt would have. Refusals: 404 first_comment_not_found when the post has none, 409 first_comment_not_retryable when it is already posted or the post has not published, and the platform's own refusal when the retry failed too.

id.description: The post whose first comment to retry. For a thread, the last part, which is the one that carries it.

idempotency_key.description: A key of your own making that makes retrying this call safe. The same key with the same request replays the first answer for 24 hours instead of sending it again; the same key with a different request is refused with 422 idempotency_key_reused, and a retry that arrives while the first is still running is refused with 409 idempotency_in_progress; a retry after the first has finished collects the replay.

name: chirpie_retry_first_comment
title: Retry a first comment
